title: A Time-Domain Pressure-Interface Model for Gas Bubble Dynamics with Surface Tension: Well-Posedness, Classical Limits, and Resonance Branches
summary: We derive and analyze a time-domain pressure--interface evolution model for a compressible gas bubble in a compressible liquid with surface tension. Starting from the nonlinear two-phase Euler free-boundary problem and linearizing about a spherical Young--Laplace equilibrium, we obtain a coupled bulk--surface hyperbolic system for the liquid pressure, the gas pressure, and the normal displacement of the interface.
